Message:
mwl8k: fix error handling in mwl8k_post_cmd()

If pci_map_single() fails in mwl8k_post_cmd(),
it returns -ENOMEM immediately, while cleanup is required.

Found by Linux Driver Verification project (linuxtesting.org).
